article.story: BUFFALO, N.Y. -- — Dylan Ducommun led Buffalo over Canisius on Sunday with 25 points off of the bench in a 79-55 win. Ducommun shot 9 for 14, including 7 for 11 from beyond the arc for the Bulls (2-2). Mikkel Tyne added 18 points and six assists while going 6 of 14 from the floor, including 3 for 9 from 3-point range, and 3 for 4 from the free-throw line. Drew Steffe shot 6 of 10 from the field, including 2 for 3 from 3-point range, and went 2 for 3 from the foul line and finished with 16 points and eight rebounds. Michael Wilson Jr. led the way for the Golden Griffins (2-3) with 20 points and 10 rebounds. Clinton Efinda added 12 points for Canisius. Preist Ryan also had nine points. Buffalo took the lead about 9 1/2 minutes into the game and did not trail again. Steffe led the Golden Griffins with 14 points in the first half to help put them up 44-31 at the break. Ducommun scored 17 points in the second half to help lead the way as Buffalo went on to secure a victory, outscoring Canisius by 11 points in the second half. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
